notes:
What’s new in 0.1.33:
• Smoother playback: library scans and conversions run in the background, so they no longer pause the film someone is watching. Lists, skipping and the home page are all much faster.
• Your own address works better away from home: Beebo opens the right ports on your router for you, and Settings shows whether it worked.
• If a network won’t allow a direct connection, you get a clear message and a link to the new connection test instead of an endless spinner.
• Safer: nobody can pretend to be your computer, one person’s wrong passwords can’t lock out everyone else, and your email password and TMDB key are now stored encrypted.
• Optional: use a relay on your own Cloudflare account for tricky networks. It’s off unless you turn it on, and Settings shows the cost.
• “Convert whole show” no longer dates episodes 1 January 1970. Kid-safe mode and the device-only trial are gone.
• Install Android 1.19 for subtitles on the next episode and one-tap BeeboTV Wi-Fi in Campsite Mode.
